name: Massachusetts Data Breach Notification Reports
regulator: Massachusetts Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation
unit_of_observation: One reporting-organization row in a reviewed annual report
source_threshold: Reports concern breaches affecting Massachusetts residents under the state reporting framework.
source_population: Reporting organizations listed in the official annual notification reports.
public_window: Bounded to the complete published 2024 through 2026 annual reports.
source_licence: Official Massachusetts public report; publication is limited to attributed factual fields and remains subject to Mass.gov terms.
attribution: Massachusetts Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation
correction_process: Check the current official annual reports and report index; do not retrieve or reproduce consumer notification letters.
limitations: The reporting organization may differ from every affected entity.
Coverage is bounded to the reviewed 2024 through 2026 annual reports rather than the full series beginning in 2007.
Affected-resident totals may change as reporting organizations update counts.
The source can publish placeholder and duplicate-marker rows without independent notification facts; those rows are counted and excluded.
